$comment: RAHU — Dimension-style AI coworker, 100% Google ecosystem, no separate UI. Outputs land as Gmail drafts/labels, Calendar events, Google Tasks, and Google Docs. >>> REVIEW THIS FILE, then copy it to .claude/settings.json to activate. It is shipped as .example so nothing auto-grants permissions or registers hooks without your explicit opt-in. <<<
$comment_model: Default = Sonnet (good writing + reasoning). Per-task overrides live in each agent's frontmatter: Haiku for high-volume triage/extraction, Opus for deal/IC-memo deep reasoning. See README 'Model routing'.
$comment_no_mcp_here: The Google server is declared ONCE, in the repo-root .mcp.json — NOT here. `mcpServers` is not a settings.json key, so a copy here is silently ignored (or shadows .mcp.json); either way it drifts. A duplicate block used to live here and had already diverged, hardcoding Asia/Kolkata while .mcp.json honored ${WORKSPACE_MCP_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE:-UTC}. Set the timezone by exporting that variable.
$comment_alt_mcp: Zero-setup alternative: the claude.ai-hosted Gmail / Google Calendar / Google Drive connectors need no OAuth app. They lack Google Tasks. NOTE: they also expose DIFFERENT tool names (mcp__claude_ai_Gmail__*), which the agents' tools: lists and the permissions below do NOT yet cover — see ROADMAP.
$comment_permissions: SAFETY POSTURE: RAHU drafts, labels, and prepares — it never sends mail or creates calendar invites without a human OK (those two are in 'ask'). This mirrors Dimension's review-and-send default. Flip gmail_send_message into 'allow' only if you knowingly opt into true Inbox-Autopilot auto-send.

hooks.$comment_hooks: Optional. Enable by copying into settings.json. SessionStart injects a compact memory digest so agents start context-aware for ~0 extra tokens. PreToolUse on send is a belt-and-suspenders guard.

PreToolUse.$comment: Regex matcher (not an exact name) so the send-latch fires for ANY Gmail send tool — the self-hosted workspace-mcp (gmail_send_message) AND the claude.ai-hosted Gmail connector (send_email / send_message), which is named differently. Case classes are explicit: Claude Code compiles this with JS RegExp, where a leading (?i) is a COMPILE ERROR that silently disables the latch entirely. Do not reintroduce it.
